csv_project_name: Design for Ridgefield NWR Visitor Service Center
csv_agency: FWS, Division Of Contracting and FA
csv_scope_of_work: Interpretive Exhibit for Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge Visitor Service Center. This project shall be the planning, design, fabrication, and installation of new exhibits at Ridgefield NWR. The project includes coordination, via the appointed contracting officer s representative (COR), with refuge staff, and regional office staff. The Contractor will develop an exhibit concept plan working with the staff of CONWR. The concept plan will be the initial step in the design process to develop an overall theme and design direction for the exhibits that fits the space, setting, and meets the outlined visitor objectives.
